reuse.why: The rule change is made inside the existing shared getRangeAmount/getExpectedAmount, which every caller (forecast, schedules app, budget templates, API model, UI via getScheduledAmount) already uses; getApproxNumberThreshold is kept for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No new logic is added outside the shared definition; the change simplifies it (Math.min, single subtraction).

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines it; callers only get comment updates.

scope.why: Core rule change, comment wording at call sites, the matching tests and release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: One-place rule change that is easy to own; the pre-existing computeSchedulePreviewTransactions dispatch that bypasses getExpectedAmount for numeric amounts (so ignores isapprox there) was left as is.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All changes go through getRangeAmount/getExpectedAmount in shared/schedules.ts.
